metadata.content:
*You tumble through the battle, stabbing foes and [teleporting](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) allies.*

| **Magic, [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), Weapon** | **Main action** |
|--------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 Self; see below**   |     **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to twice your [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed), making one [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) that targets each creature you come [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to during the [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting).

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility):**

- **≤11:** An enemy takes 6 damage; an ally can [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to 3 squares.
- **12-16:** An enemy takes 10 damage; an ally can [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to 5 squares.
- **17+:** An enemy takes 14 damage; an ally can [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to 7 squares.
